correctness.rationale: For each finite Hamming Cartesian product, every positive-dimensional clique uniquely lies in a coordinate-line simplex. The unaugmented chain surjection from the direct sum of line-simplex chains gives an exact equivariant incidence-kernel formula for H1, with higher homology vanishing. Splitting each Q[A_i] into normalized constants plus sum-zero U_i makes the kernel equations c_i=0 outside S and sum_{i in S} c_i=0, giving precisely E_S tensor products. Equivariant combinatorial Alexander duality gives the full vertex-permutation sign twist and degree N-4, and the incidence character identity gives 1−ℓ+(d−1)v. Exact replay enumerated full small group actions (140 elements), 36 additional generator traces, and five independent mod-2 homology ranks; all matched. Finite experiments are not treated as infinite proof.

value.rationale: The 2026 all-parameter result computes sphere counts but not induced symmetries. Determining the complete representation of all coordinate and equal-axis permutations is a motivated infinite-family refinement; it proves the structural exclusion of one-coordinate homology constituents, identifies every higher-interaction tensor irreducible and its multiplicity for the alphabet subgroup, and gives nonidentity characters, none of which follows from rank data alone. The theorem is nontrivial even though its argument uses elementary natural chain models; no downstream paper-sized significance or external audit is claimed.
